_doc: Source-purification status per book. raw = untouched OCR backlog; purifying = in progress; pristine = book_purity scan at 0 unresolved and GUARDED by the book_source_clean invariant (may never regress above 0). Set to 'pristine' only after a full audited purification and an owner sign-off.
_pristine_caveat: book_purity=0 is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT - the scanner is BLIND to subscript-comma OCR damage (B,->B6, CO,->CO2) and reading-order scrambles. Mining cleans only shown verbatims; the whole-book source-cosmetic cleanup is a SOMEDAY one-shot EXHAUSTIVE human scan-read of every page (owed, self-defining worklist). NEVER flip a book to 'pristine' on scan=0 alone - it needs that human exhaustive-read sign-off.
